b_only.addressee: European Commission; importers of goods originating in third countries listed in Annex III
b_only.benefit_or_duty: A third country or territory may be added to or removed from the Annex III exemption lists by delegated act, including as a consequence of CBAM incorporation into the EEA Agreement, and under urgency where imperative grounds require it.

b_only.addressee: Authorised CBAM declarants and third-country operators procuring verification
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Use a verifier accredited by a national accreditation body of a Member State, there being no route to recognition of a third-country accreditation body.

b_only.article: Art. 1(5)(b), replacing the first sentence of Art. 6(6) of Regulation (EU) 2023/956
b_only.addressee: Authorised CBAM declarants; European Commission as the act's author
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Report, in the standard declaration format, the detail supporting each total -- per installation and country of origin -- including the carbon price paid and the default carbon price for the purposes of Art. 9(4).
Designate, by implementing act, the goods or goods/origin combinations for which traceability evidence must accompany the declaration, and the type of evidence required.

b_only.article: Art. 1(7)(b)(2), adding a subparagraph to Art. 9(5) of Regulation (EU) 2023/956
b_only.addressee: Authorised CBAM declarants claiming a carbon price paid in a third country
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Use a certifying person holding accreditation from a national accreditation body, following specified certification procedures and subject to information exchange with accreditation bodies, the Commission and competent authorities.

b_only.article: Art. 1(15)(c), replacing the first sentence of Art. 25(6) of Regulation (EU) 2023/956
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Communicate customs information at the scope, periodicity, timing and by the means the implementing acts prescribe.

b_only.article: Art. 1(21); Annex I, point (1) replacing the 'Iron and Steel' table in point 2 of Annex I of Regulation (EU) 2023/956
b_only.addressee: Importers and authorised CBAM declarants of the newly listed iron and steel goods
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Declare embedded emissions and surrender certificates for goods newly added to the 'Iron and steel' table -- agglomerated iron ore, stranded wire and cables, unplated welded grill and netting, springs, enamelled and other household articles, and other cast articles of iron or steel.

b_only.article: Art. 1(22); Annex II, point (1) replacing point (e) of point 1 of Annex IV of Regulation (EU) 2023/956
b_only.addressee: Importers and authorised CBAM declarants of electricity and of goods with indirect emissions
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Use, as the emission factor for electricity, the weighted average CO2 intensity of all electricity produced in the geographic area, in place of a factor representing the emission intensity of the electricity consumed in producing the goods.

b_only.article: Art. 1(22); Annex II, point (1) replacing point (f) of point 1 of Annex IV of Regulation (EU) 2023/956
b_only.addressee: Importers and authorised CBAM declarants of electricity claiming actual emissions
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Hold a power purchase agreement that involves the physical delivery of electricity, not merely a direct contractual purchase, in order to claim actual embedded emissions for imported electricity.
